newsitem.title: UK: NWE mogas firms on tightness but market slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE mogas firms on tightness but market slow.

text.p: NWE gasoline trundled higher on Friday as the market reacted to a couple of refinery shut-downs and recent arbing to the United States.
Dealers said gasoline swaps were up to $2 stronger with August at $185.50-186.00 and September at $184.50-185.00.
"It is pretty quiet at the moment, but there is tightness in NWE for high octane material," said one dealer.
Cargoes for premium unleaded were hoveringaround $189 cif NWE.
